posts.title: Focus Flow: Lo-Fi Study Beats Vol. 1
posts.feed_hook:
Lamp on. Coffee warm.
Head down, pages turning.

video_frames.hook:
Lamp on.
Coffee warm.

posts.instagram:
Lamp on. Coffee warm. Head down, pages turning.

On the cover of Focus Flow, a young woman in headphones and glasses rests her chin in her hand and writes in an open notebook, a desk lamp glowing beside her coffee mug while the evening sky fades outside the window. It's lo-fi hip-hop study beats from Resonant Theory.

Made for deep focus and background listening, so put it on for tonight's study session or the work you keep putting off.

posts.feed_hook:
Greens on the table.
Nowhere else to be.

video_frames.hook:
Greens on
the table.

posts.instagram:
Greens on the table. Nowhere else to be.

On the cover of Sweet Like Sunday Greens, a couple leans in forehead to forehead at a candlelit table set with bowls of greens, a plate of bread and two glasses of red wine. It's a smooth R&B and soul single from Slamdino Entertainment ft. Brodrick Wilson.

Made for the Sunday wind down, after dinner and before the week starts.
